title: •Molator
caption: •Molator (V)
game_text: Deploy on table. If your character in battle is about to be lost before the damage segment, it is instead lost at end of battle (if forfeited, forfeit for 0). Characters of ability < 5 are immune to Goo Nee Tay. {alter}
lore: Creature in *dejarik* hologame drawn from Alderaanian mythology. Stories describe molators as powerful, enchanted protectors of Alderaanian kings and queens.
